en: This black and white postcard shows a street scene with two large, ornate European-style buildings standing at the intersection. The left building features classical architectural elements with decorative rooftop finials, and signs in German advertising a restaurant ('Restaurant'), billiards, and other services. The right building has a distinctive turret-like corner and signage that reads 'Bade- & Wasseranlage' and 'H. Haber.' Several people, including children, are visible on the quiet street. Trees line the street and a wooden fence is visible in the left foreground.
